0 / 留空 = 默认；不支持的家忽略，实际采样率看出参: 0 / empty = default; ignored by providers that don't support it — check the output field for the actual sample rate
0 = 没走到 HTTP（网络不通 / 地址解析失败）: 0 = the request never reached HTTP (network unreachable / DNS resolution failed)
Form=inline 时是 data URL；Form=uri 时是地址: A data URL when Form=inline; a URL when Form=uri
audio_seconds（音频秒数）/ token 各家能给几项给几项: audio_seconds / token — each provider gives whichever fields it can
characters（字符）/ token 各家能给几项给几项，平台按部署的计价: characters / token — each provider gives whichever fields it can; the platform uses whichever unit the deployment is priced in
inline data URL（平台把字节交给实现）: inline data URL (the platform hands the bytes to the implementation)
inline data URL；MIME 与容器一致（audio/mpeg /: inline data URL; MIME matches the container (audio/mpeg / audio/wav)
inline=data URL；uri=上游给的地址: inline = data URL; uri = the URL given by the upstream provider
inline=平台传字节（data URL）；uri=只给地址，模型自己去取: inline = the platform sends the bytes (data URL); uri = only a URL is given, and the model fetches it itself
mp3 / wav / pcm16；留空 = mp3。pcm16 由实现裹成 W: mp3 / wav / pcm16; empty = mp3. pcm16 is wrapped as WAV by the implementation before being returned
上游改写过请求文本时（润色 / 自动生成播报稿）给出；空 = 念的就是请求文本: Given when the upstream has rewritten the requested text (polishing / auto-generating a script); empty = the text spoken is exactly the requested text
不可用时是原因与下一步；**base_url 填错通常表现为 404 而不是 4: The reason and next step when unavailable; **a wrong base_url usually shows up as 404, not 401** — the message distinguishes the two
与上游返回同集；顺序按 id 稳定排序: Same set as the upstream response; sorted stably by id
函数参数的形状由调用方定义，是任意 JSON Schema: The function's parameter shape is defined by the caller as an arbitrary JSON Schema
厂商专属参数，形状由上游 API 决定: Provider-specific parameters; their shape is determined by the upstream API
厂商专属参数，形状由上游 API 决定；已有键不覆盖，对象键下钻一层合并: Provider-specific parameters; their shape is determined by the upstream API. Existing keys are not overwritten; object keys are merged one level deep
厂商私有,平台与别家都不解释: Provider-specific; neither the platform nor other providers interpret it
参数形状由该函数的 JSON Schema 决定，运行期才知道: The parameter shape is determined by this function's JSON Schema and is only known at runtime
各家自己的音色 id；留空 = 这家的默认音色: The provider's own voice id; empty = that provider's default voice
同 chat，但边生成边产出增量: Same as chat, but produces incremental deltas as it generates
小米 MiMo 系列模型接入（OpenAI 兼容协议）：MiMo-V2.6 对话: Integration for the Xiaomi MiMo model family (OpenAI-compatible protocol): MiMo-V2.6 chat (thinking toggle), MiMo-V2.5-TTS speech synthesis (preset voices / voice design / voice cloning), and MiMo-V2.5-ASR speech recognition.
平台据此判断能力降级与 failover: The platform uses this to decide capability degradation and failover
平台的 canonical 请求（模型名已解析为上游真名）: The platform's canonical request (the model name has been resolved to its real upstream name)
形状由该函数的 JSON Schema 决定，运行期才知道: The shape is determined by this function's JSON Schema and is only known at runtime
拿这条凭证问一次上游「有哪些模型」，给部署编辑的模型名下拉用: Uses this credential to ask the upstream provider once for its model list, for the model-name dropdown in the deployment editor
拿这条凭证问一次上游的模型列表，验证 key 与 base_url 都对: Uses this credential to fetch the upstream model list once, verifying both the key and base_url are correct
按 canonical 请求调用上游模型，返回完整回答: Calls the upstream model with the canonical request and returns the full response
某语音合成模型可选的预置音色；custom=true 表示可 / 需自由填写（音: Preset voices offered by some text-to-speech models; custom=true means a voice id can/must be entered freely (voice cloning, voice design, compatibility gateways)
模型产出的图 / 音频等（inline=data URL，uri=地址）；只在请: Images/audio etc. produced by the model (inline = data URL, uri = URL); only appears when the corresponding output modality was requested
由调用方给出，形状随其业务而定: Given by the caller; its shape depends on their use case
结构化输出的结果，形状由调用方给的 JSON Schema 决定: The structured-output result, whose shape is determined by the JSON Schema the caller provided
给识别器的上下文 / 专有名词；不支持的家忽略: Context / proper nouns for the recognizer; ignored by providers that don't support it
自然语言的语气 / 情绪 / 角色描述，不会被念出来；不支持的家忽略: A natural-language description of tone / emotion / character that won't be spoken aloud; ignored by providers that don't support it
要念的文本；风格标签（如 (开心) / [笑]）算文本的一部分，原样透传: The text to be spoken; style tags (e.g. (happy) / [laughs]) are treated as part of the text and passed through as-is
识别出的语种；空 = 上游没说: The detected language; empty = the upstream didn't say
请求的推理语义被就近执行时的一句提示（如 GLM-5.3 家族关不掉思考）；空: A note shown when the requested reasoning semantics were approximated (e.g. the GLM-5.3 family can't turn thinking off); empty = executed faithfully
部署级透传给上游的额外 body 字段，形状由上游 API 决定: Extra body fields passed through to the upstream at the deployment level; their shape is determined by the upstream API
音色复刻的样本音频（inline data URL）；只有支持复刻的模型认它: Sample audio for voice cloning (inline data URL); only honored by models that support cloning
